newsitem.title: UK: GrandMet sticks by merger partner.
newsitem.headline: GrandMet sticks by merger partner.

text.p: British food and drinks company Grand Metropolitan Plc stuck by its merger partner Guinness Plc on Wednesday, saying LVMH's threat to buy Guinness out of their joint venture companies does not affect their merger plans.
"Clearly the issue was looked at ahead of the merger announcement and we are confident that it will not affect in any way our proposed merger," said a GrandMet spokesman.
LVMH said it believed the merger would create a "control event" that would allow it to exercise its option to buy Guinness' interests in their joint ventures at net asset value.
France's LVMH, which holds a 14.2 percent stake in Guinness reiterated its opposition to the Guinness/GrandMet deal, which would create a food and drinks guant worth more than 20 billion pounds.
